svg.text: Bravura 1.482 at 30 px per staff space
the glyphs BravuraGlyphs.kt holds, assembled with the font's own anchors and engraving defaults
the header block is 4 staff spaces wide
head on G4, flags on Bravura's anchors
isolated, then hung to the left of a head
on a line note the dot lifts into the space above
the written range runs past the staff both ways
the same glyphs as one line of music
